traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz's account of the black mangroves (Avicenniaceae), as search results quote it (the page itself was not read): they differ from Acanthaceae in their regular corolla. The Flora of the Cayman Islands (Plants of the World Online) gives a corolla of a short tube and 4 almost equal spreading lobes; PROTA calls it slightly zygomorphic; calyx 5, stamens 4 in the throat (as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read). Drawn regular, 4-merous.
